units.rawText: To be honest, all of that "saving everyone", all that "reality and the cloud", I don't really understand what all of that means.

units.rawText: The operands I can spare for neural operations are not plentiful in the first place, and I need to spare some for these kids.

units.rawText: Perhaps I only maintain this decorum for the sake of commands, or maybe my coldness is just some sort of crass imitation—but at least there is someone I can speak these worries to now.

units.rawText: And that person's answers will assure me that what dignity I have maintained for myself was no mere delusion of grandeur... right, Professor?
